app_release_notes: v1.17.2 - Barrel tuner: the recommended setting now always uses the same numbers as your settings table, and tuner tests count up from your start setting, the way tuner instructions run. Enter your seating length as COAL as well as CBTO or a jump. Results and your Recipe Card say which one you measured. New Every shot button on Results shows every shot's speed, and long strings now count every shot. Double-click a load in Libraries to open it. Plus fixes and improvements.
